name: com.visioforge/sdk-docs
title: VisioForge SDK Assistant
description: VisioForge .NET SDK assistant: API reference, code examples and deployment guides.

tools.name: list_media_blocks
tools.description: List available VisioForge media blocks, optionally filtered by category. Media blocks are the building blocks of media processing pipelines. Categories include: Sources, Sinks, VideoEncoders, AudioEncoders, VideoDecoders, VideoProcessing, AudioProcessing, AudioRendering, VideoRendering, Demuxers, Parsers, OpenGL, OpenCV, Nvidia, Decklink, AWS, RTSPServer, Bridge, Special, Outputs.

category.description: Optional category to filter by (e.g., 'Sources', 'Sinks', 'VideoEncoders'). Leave empty to list all categories with their blocks.

tools.name: get_nuget_packages_snippet
tools.description: Get .csproj snippet with required NuGet packages for a specific deployment scenario. Returns XML snippet ready to copy-paste into your project file.

platform.description: Target platform, required. One of: Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS, macCatalyst.

projectType.description: Project type, required. One of: WPF, WinForms, WinUI, Console, MAUI, Avalonia, Uno, Blazor. MAUI, Avalonia and Uno are treated as multi-target, so the native redists are emitted under a target-framework condition; the rest get them unconditionally.

sdkType.description: SDK type, required. VideoCapture for camera/screen/IP-camera recording, MediaPlayer for playback, VideoEdit for timeline editing — those are the three products. MediaBlocks is the low-level pipeline layer, for custom source-to-encoder graphs only; do not pick it for an ordinary capture, playback or editing app.

includeOptional.description: Include optional packages? (e.g., OpenCV, AWS, specialized camera support)

tools.name: get_enum_values
tools.description: Get all values of a VisioForge SDK enum type with descriptions. Useful for understanding available options for configuration properties (e.g., MediaBlockType, video codecs, audio formats, pixel formats).

enumName.description: Enum name (e.g., 'MediaBlockType', 'MediaBlockPadMediaType', 'MediaBlockPadDirection'). Can be short name or fully qualified.

filter.description: Optional text filter to show only matching enum values (e.g., 'H264' to find H264-related values)

tools.name: list_sdk_classes
tools.description: List core VisioForge SDK classes. These are the main entry-point classes for building media applications: VideoCaptureCoreX (video capture/recording), VideoEditCoreX (video editing), MediaPlayerCoreX (media playback), MediaInfoReaderX (media analysis), SimplePlayerCoreX (simple playback), and more.

tools.name: list_namespaces
tools.description: Browse VisioForge SDK namespaces hierarchically. Shows child namespaces and classes within a given namespace. Start with 'VisioForge.Core' or leave empty to see top-level namespaces.

parentNamespace.description: Parent namespace to browse (e.g., 'VisioForge.Core.MediaBlocks'). Leave empty for top-level.

tools.name: get_platform_specific_config
tools.description: Get platform-specific file copying/build configuration code. Returns MSBuild targets or post-build scripts for special deployment requirements.

platform.description: Platform: Windows, macOS, maccatalyst, Android, iOS, Linux

tools.name: search_api
tools.description: Search across the entire VisioForge SDK API — class names, method names, property names, event names, and their documentation text. Returns ranked results. Use this when you don't know the exact class name, or to find all classes related to a concept (e.g., 'RTSP streaming', 'video overlay', 'audio capture').

query.description: Search query — can be a class name, method name, concept, or description (e.g., 'RTSP', 'video resize', 'audio equalizer', 'H264 encoder settings')

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20, max: 50)

tools.name: get_media_block_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific media block including its properties, methods, events, input/output pads, constructor parameters, and documentation. Use this to understand how to configure and use a specific media block in a pipeline.

blockName.description: Name of the media block (e.g., 'H264EncoderBlock', 'RTSPSourceBlock', 'MP4SinkBlock'). Can be the short name or full qualified name.

tools.name: get_pipeline_template
tools.description: Get a media block pipeline template for a specific use case. Returns the list of required blocks and how to connect them, along with C# code to build the pipeline.

useCase.description: Use case description. Available templates: 'rtsp-to-mp4' (record network camera to file), 'webcam-preview' (show webcam on screen), 'webcam-to-rtmp' (stream webcam live), 'file-transcode' (convert video file format), 'screen-to-hls' (screen capture to HLS stream), 'multi-source-mix' (mix multiple video sources), 'audio-only-capture' (record audio to file), 'ndi-output' (stream via NDI protocol)

tools.name: get_class_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about any VisioForge SDK class, including its full list of properties, methods, events, constructors, base class, interfaces, and documentation. Works for both core SDK classes and media blocks.

className.description: Class name (e.g., 'VideoCaptureCoreX', 'H264EncoderSettings', 'MP4SinkSettings'). Can be short name or fully qualified.

tools.name: get_method_signature
tools.description: Get the detailed signature and documentation for a specific method on a class. Useful when you need to understand a method's parameters, return type, and behavior.

className.description: The class name that contains the method

methodName.description: The method name to look up

tools.name: list_deployment_guides
tools.description: List available deployment guides for VisioForge SDK. Filter by platform, project type, SDK type, or scenario. Returns a list of guides with titles, summaries, and tags.

platform.description: Filter by platform (optional). Values: Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS, All

projectType.description: Filter by project type (optional). Values: WPF, WinForms, MAUI, Avalonia, Console, Uno, Blazor

sdkType.description: Filter by SDK (optional). Values: MediaBlocks, VideoCapture, MediaPlayer, VideoEdit

tag.description: Filter by tag (optional). Values: docker, cloud, mobile, desktop, rtsp, streaming

tools.name: get_code_example
tools.description: Get a code example for a common VisioForge SDK scenario. Returns complete, working C# code snippets that demonstrate how to use the SDK for tasks like video capture, RTSP streaming, media playback, and more.

scenario.description: Scenario name. Available: 'webcam-capture' (capture from webcam to MP4), 'rtsp-playback' (play RTSP stream), 'rtsp-to-mp4' (record RTSP to MP4 file), 'webcam-to-rtmp' (stream webcam to RTMP/YouTube/Facebook), 'file-playback' (play a media file), 'video-editing' (basic video editing), 'screen-capture' (capture screen to file), 'media-info' (read media file information), 'pipeline-basic' (build a basic media block pipeline), 'virtual-source' (generate test video/audio), 'hls-streaming' (stream to HLS), 'audio-capture' (capture audio only)

tools.name: get_deployment_guide
tools.description: Get the complete deployment guide for a specific scenario. Returns detailed instructions, code snippets, NuGet packages, and platform-specific notes.
